text:
Maya Chen: hi everyone — starting a quick coordination thread for LumenArc's preview enrollment. They've accepted seats but we have a few compliance and adoption risks to sort before they can ramp.
Samir Patel: got it. which features are in scope for them? and who is the customer contact?
Maya Chen: scope = streaming embeddings, rerank endpoint, and automated prefix caching. Contact = Taylor (customer sponsor). Seats = 5 total (sponsor + 3 DS + 1 infra).
Priya Nair: InfoSec flagged SSO and audit logs as must-haves. Without those they won't move to production and that raises a renewal risk (renewal window in ~4 months).
Jorge Alvarez: engineering asked for expected traffic profile and a short operations runbook. I'll draft a one-page doc with QPS/burst numbers and a quick failover checklist.
Maya Chen: actions: (1) Priya coordinate SAML setup and get IdP metadata, (2) Jorge draft runbook, (3) Samir schedule enablement. Target: resolve major blockers within 10 business days.
Samir Patel: enablement invite sent for Tue 10am PT. Agenda: SSO checklist, rerank demo under load, smoke test for cache, feedback capture flow.
Taylor (LumenArc): Tue 10 works. I'll DM SAML metadata and our security reviewer contact. Audit logs are critical for our compliance team.
onboard-bot: preview-seat-provisioned: lumenarc-org seats=5 ids=[s-301,s-302,s-303,s-304,s-305]
Priya Nair: Taylor — please DM IdP metadata and point of contact. I'll align with infra to spin up SAML and confirm audit log format by Friday EOD.
Taylor (LumenArc): DM sent. Also can we get weekly token usage exports for visibility into billing and adoption?
Maya Chen: yes — product-ops will enable weekly CSV exports for their org. I'll ping them after this thread.
Jorge Alvarez: uploaded draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lumenarc-preview — includes QPS table, curl examples, and steps to switch to a fallback model variant. Please review.
Maya Chen: review done. Jorge, add a short scripted smoke test they can execute after enablement to validate KV cache and rerank correctness.
Samir Patel: added smoke test to the enablement deck. We'll have the DS lead run it live.
Priya Nair: audit logs ETA: Friday COB. I'll confirm retention window and delivery method (S3 vs syslog).
Taylor (LumenArc): thanks. one more ask: can we have an escalation contact for latency incidents during the trial window?
Maya Chen: assign Jorge as primary engineering contact, Samir as CS lead. I'll create #cs-lumenarc-trial for realtime updates during the pilot.
Samir Patel: channel created and invites sent.
Maya Chen: final note — marking this account as "high-touch preview" in RevOps and flagging renewal risk. We'll run biweekly health checks until adoption stabilizes.
Priya Nair: noted. setting biweekly pulses and adding renewal-risk tag.
Maya Chen: thanks all — will reconvene after the enablement session. Thread paused until post-session follow-up.
